Title: Requires utility service providers to disclose planned rate increases to consumers within a certain amount of time
Summary: Requires utility service providers to disclose planned rate increases to consumers within thirty days before a planned price increase takes effect; requires utility providers to provide contact information and a mechanism to cancel service completely.
LawCode: Add §28, Pub Serv L; add §399-ww, Gen Bus L; amd §1020-cc, Pub Auth L
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the public service law, the general business law and the public authorities law, in relation to requiring utility service providers to disclose planned rate increases to consumers within a certain amount of time
